zh.title: Student-Informed Teacher Training
zh.authors: Nico Messikommer, Jiaxu Xing, Elie Aljalbout, Davide Scaramuzza
zh.institutions: Robotics and Perception Group, University of Zurich
zh.mainContent: SITT 解决 privileged teacher imitation learning 中 teacher 过强、student 因部分可观测而难以模仿的问题。方法在 teacher 训练时显式考虑 student 是否能学会，把 teacher-student action 差异作为 teacher reward penalty，并加入监督式对齐步骤，使 teacher 学到更容易被视觉 student 蒸馏的行为。
innovations: 把 student learnability 纳入 teacher 训练目标，缓解 teacher-student 信息不对称。
用近似 teacher-student action difference 惩罚 teacher reward，避免 teacher 走向 student 难以模仿的策略。
结合监督式 teacher-student alignment，在 maze navigation、vision-based quadrotor flight 和 manipulation 任务上验证。
implementation: 先训练具有 privileged information 的 teacher，同时维护一个动态更新的 student 模型。
在 PPO teacher objective 中加入 student action mismatch penalty。
周期性执行 teacher-student supervised alignment，让 teacher 和 student 在训练中互相约束。
最终部署使用观测受限的 student policy。

en.title: Student-Informed Teacher Training
en.authors: Nico Messikommer, Jiaxu Xing, Elie Aljalbout, Davide Scaramuzza
en.institutions: Robotics and Perception Group, University of Zurich
en.mainContent: SITT addresses a failure mode in privileged-teacher imitation learning: a powerful teacher may learn behaviors that a partially observable student cannot imitate. The method makes teacher training student-aware by penalizing teacher-student action mismatch and adding a supervised alignment step, producing teachers whose behaviors can be distilled into vision-based student policies.
innovations: It includes student learnability directly in teacher training, reducing teacher-student asymmetry.
It penalizes approximate teacher-student action differences in the teacher reward.
It combines the penalty with supervised teacher-student alignment and evaluates on maze navigation, vision-based quadrotor flight, and manipulation tasks.
implementation: Train a privileged-information teacher while maintaining a dynamically updated student model.
Add a student action-mismatch penalty to the PPO teacher objective.
Periodically run supervised teacher-student alignment during training.
Deploy the observation-limited student policy after distillation.

zh.title: MoCapAct: A Multi-Task Dataset for Simulated Humanoid Control
zh.authors: Nolan Wagener, Andrey Kolobov, Felipe Vieira Frujeri, Ricky Loynd, Ching-An Cheng, Matthew Hausknecht
zh.institutions: Georgia Institute of Technology; Microsoft Research
zh.takeaway: 通过预计算 RL 专家策略并开源其 rollout 数据，将高维人形机器人运动跟踪的准入门槛从 50 年分布式 RL 降至 3 小时监督学习。
zh.mainContent: 针对公开 MoCap 数据仅含运动学信息、物理跟踪需大规模 RL 计算的问题，本文训练并发布了 MoCapAct 数据集——包含能跟踪 3.5 小时 CMU MoCap 数据的专家策略及其噪声注入 rollout。基于该数据集，通过蒸馏训练了单一多片段跟踪策略，并复用其低层解码器加速下游 RL 任务；此外训练了 GPT 模型实现给定运动提示后的物理仿真运动补全。
innovations: 首次公开与 CMU MoCap 配套的大规模物理控制数据集（含专家策略、观测、动作、奖励、价值与优势估计），覆盖 3.5 小时运动数据。
提出两阶段研究范式：先以 PPO 并行训练 2589 个逐片段专家（总计约 50 年 wall-clock），再以监督学习/蒸馏训练统一多片段策略，单 GPU 仅需约 3 小时。
系统比较 BC/CWR/AWR/RWR 四种加权蒸馏方案，证明 Reward-Weighted Regression 最优（较 BC 提升约 5%）。
将 minGPT adapted 到连续控制域，仅基于历史观测自回归生成动作，实现物理仿真器中的运动补全。
implementation: 环境：dm_control CMU Humanoid（56 关节，MuJoCo 后端），动作空间为目标关节角度，经 PD 控制器转换为力矩。
阶段一（专家训练）：Stable-Baselines3 PPO；策略网络为 3 层 1024 神经元 MLP，tanh 激活；每 snippet 训练 150M 环境步，采用 RSI 初始化和早终止条件；动作分布固定标准差 σ=0.1；共 2589 个 snippet。
阶段二（数据采集）：对每个专家执行 200 次噪声注入 rollout（Large 版）或 20 次（Small 版），记录状态、参考轨迹、采样动作、均值动作、奖励、价值与优势；Large 版 600 GB 共 67M transitions，Small 版 50 GB 共 5.5M transitions。

阶段三（多片段策略）：Encoder-Decoder 架构；Encoder 为 2 层 1024 神经元 MLP（LayerNorm+ELU），输出 60 维高斯意图 z_t；Decoder 为 3 层 1024 神经元 MLP，输出 56 维动作均值（固定 σ=0.1）；优化目标为加权 log 似然减去 β·KL 散度（β=0.1，先验 α=0）；Adam 学习率 5e-4，序列长度 T=30，batch size 256，单 GPU 约 3 小时/50k 步收敛。
阶段四（GPT）：基于 minGPT adapted 至连续输入/输出，57M 参数，8 层 8 头 768 维嵌入，上下文 32 步；以 MSE 损失自回归预测动作；PyTorch Lightning 训练 2M 步约 1 周（4×V100）。

en.title: MoCapAct: A Multi-Task Dataset for Simulated Humanoid Control
en.authors: Nolan Wagener, Andrey Kolobov, Felipe Vieira Frujeri, Ricky Loynd, Ching-An Cheng, Matthew Hausknecht
en.institutions: Georgia Institute of Technology; Microsoft Research
en.takeaway: By precomputing RL expert policies and open-sourcing their noisy rollouts, the paper lowers the barrier of humanoid motion tracking from 50 years of distributed RL to 3 hours of supervised learning.
en.mainContent: To address the problem that public MoCap data contains only kinematic information while physics-based tracking requires prohibitive RL computation, this paper trains and releases MoCapAct—a dataset of expert policies and their rollouts covering 3.5 hours of CMU MoCap. Using this dataset, the authors distill a single multi-clip tracking policy and reuse its low-level decoder to accelerate downstream RL tasks; they also train a GPT model for motion completion in physics simulation given a prompt.
innovations: First large-scale public dataset of physics-based control actions paired with CMU MoCap, including expert policies, proprioceptive observations, actions, rewards, values, and advantages.
Two-stage paradigm: first train 2589 per-snippet experts with PPO (~50 years wall-clock in parallel), then distill a unified multi-clip policy via supervised learning in ~3 hours on a single GPU.
Systematic comparison of BC/CWR/AWR/RWR weighted regression, showing Reward-Weighted Regression is best (~5% over BC).
Adaptation of minGPT to continuous control for autoregressive motion completion in a physics simulator using only historical observations.
implementation: Environment: dm_control CMU Humanoid (56 DoF, MuJoCo backend). Action space is target joint angles converted to torques via PD controllers.
Stage 1 (Expert training): Stable-Baselines3 PPO; 3-layer 1024-unit MLP with tanh; 150M env steps per snippet with RSI and early termination; fixed action std σ=0.1; 2589 snippets total.

Stage 2 (Dataset generation): 200 noisy rollouts per snippet (Large) or 20 (Small), logging states, references, sampled actions, mean actions, rewards, values, and advantages; Large: 600 GB / 67M transitions; Small: 50 GB / 5.5M transitions.

Stage 3 (Multi-clip policy): Encoder-decoder; Encoder is 2-layer 1024-unit MLP (LayerNorm+ELU) outputting 60-dim Gaussian intention z_t; Decoder is 3-layer 1024-unit MLP outputting 56-dim action mean (fixed σ=0.1); objective is weighted log-likelihood minus β·KL (β=0.1, prior α=0); Adam lr=5e-4, sequence length T=30, batch size 256, ~3 hours / 50k steps on one GPU.

Stage 4 (GPT): minGPT adapted to continuous inputs/outputs, 57M params, 8 layers, 8 heads, 768 dim, context 32 steps; MSE loss for autoregressive action prediction; trained 2M steps over ~1 week on 4×V100.

zh.title: BeyondMimic: From Motion Tracking to Versatile Humanoid Control via Guided Diffusion
zh.authors: Qiayuan Liao, Takara E. Truong, Xiaoyu Huang, Yuman Gao, Guy Tevet, Koushil Sreenath, C. Karen Liu
zh.institutions: University of California, Berkeley; Stanford University
zh.takeaway: 这篇论文把人类动作模仿从“跟踪参考轨迹”推进到“用人类运动先验和 guided diffusion 在测试时组合技能解决新任务”。
zh.mainContent: BeyondMimic 面向人形机器人的敏捷、自然和通用控制问题，目标是让机器人从多样的人类动作中学习可真实部署的运动技能，并在测试时组合这些技能解决未见任务。方法分为两阶段：先用统一的 RL motion tracking formulation 学习大量人类动作，再训练 latent state-action diffusion model，通过 classifier guidance 在推理阶段优化 joystick、waypoint、motion inpainting 和 obstacle avoidance 等任务。论文展示了真实机器人上的高动态动作、自然走跑、户外部署和零样本任务组合能力。
innovations: 提出紧凑的 motion-tracking formulation，使用统一 task-space tracking reward 和少量物理一致性正则，在多种动作上共享超参数并减少 motion-specific tuning。
使用 anchor-centered relative body tracking，使策略在保留动作风格的同时允许由扰动和 sim-to-real gap 引起的全局漂移。
提出 latent state-action diffusion model，同时预测未来状态和 latent actions，使任务 cost 可以作用在未来状态上，并通过 guided diffusion 影响当前控制动作。
利用 classifier guidance 在测试时对未见任务进行在线优化，实现 joystick teleoperation、waypoint navigation、motion inpainting 和 obstacle avoidance，而不需要任务特定训练或微调。
implementation: 第一阶段将 retargeted human motion 表示为机器人广义位置和速度，通过 forward kinematics 得到目标 body pose/twist，并用 RL 训练 motion-tracking policy。
tracking reward 由 position、orientation、linear velocity、angular velocity 的 task-space tracking 项组成，并加入 joint limit、action smoothness 和 self-contact penalty 三类正则。
policy observation 包含 motion phase、anchor pose error、IMU twist、关节位置/速度和上一时刻 action；action 为 normalized joint position setpoints，经低层 PD controller 转换为执行器输入。
domain randomization 主要作用于地面摩擦和恢复系数、默认关节位置、躯干 CoM 位置，并加入随机速度扰动；论文强调避免过度随机化。
第二阶段先训练 conditional VAE，将 motion intent 编码为 latent，再用 VAE rollout 生成 state-latent trajectories 训练 diffusion model。
部署时 diffusion model 以 receding-horizon 方式生成未来短时域轨迹，并用 differentiable task cost 进行 guidance；当前 latent 由 VAE decoder 结合最新 proprioception 解码为当前 action。
真实部署使用低延迟 C++ 框架；论文强调延迟、armature、actuator modeling 和系统同步对 sim-to-real transfer 很关键。

en.title: BeyondMimic: From Motion Tracking to Versatile Humanoid Control via Guided Diffusion
en.authors: Qiayuan Liao, Takara E. Truong, Xiaoyu Huang, Yuman Gao, Guy Tevet, Koushil Sreenath, C. Karen Liu
en.institutions: University of California, Berkeley; Stanford University
en.takeaway: This paper moves humanoid imitation beyond tracking reference clips by turning human motion into a guided diffusion prior for test-time skill composition.
en.mainContent: BeyondMimic studies how to achieve agile, natural, and versatile humanoid control from diverse human motion data. The framework first trains scalable RL motion-tracking policies with a compact shared formulation, then learns a latent state-action diffusion model that can be guided at inference time by task costs. The resulting controller is demonstrated on real humanoid hardware for dynamic motions, natural walking and running, joystick control, waypoint navigation, motion inpainting, and obstacle avoidance.
innovations: A compact and motion-agnostic tracking formulation with unified task-space rewards and only a few physically motivated regularizers, reducing the need for motion-specific tuning.
Anchor-centered relative body tracking that preserves motion style while tolerating global drift caused by perturbations and sim-to-real mismatch.
A latent state-action diffusion model that predicts future states and latent actions jointly, enabling task costs to guide future states and affect current actions.

Classifier-guided test-time optimization for unseen downstream tasks such as joystick teleoperation, waypoint navigation, motion inpainting, and obstacle avoidance without task-specific retraining or fine-tuning.
implementation: Stage one retargets human motion into robot generalized positions and velocities, computes target body poses and twists through forward kinematics, and trains RL motion-tracking policies.
The tracking reward includes task-space position, orientation, linear velocity, and angular velocity terms, plus joint-limit, action-smoothness, and self-contact penalties.

The policy observation includes motion phase, anchor pose error, IMU twist, joint positions and velocities, and the previous action; the action is a normalized joint position setpoint executed through low-level PD control.

Domain randomization is applied to ground friction and restitution, default joint positions, torso center of mass, and random velocity perturbations; the paper emphasizes avoiding excessive randomization.
Stage two trains a conditional VAE to encode motion intent into a latent space, then rolls out the VAE to collect state-latent trajectories for diffusion training.

At deployment, the diffusion model generates short-horizon trajectories in a receding-horizon manner and incorporates differentiable task costs through classifier guidance; the current latent is decoded into an action using the latest proprioception.

The real-robot deployment uses a low-latency C++ framework, and the paper highlights latency, armature modeling, actuator modeling, and system synchronization as important factors for sim-to-real transfer.

zh.title: Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
zh.authors: Weishuai Zeng, Shunlin Lu, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu, Minyue Dai, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang
zh.institutions: Peking University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Fudan University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
zh.takeaway: 把不同人形机器人 WBC 任务统一为行为生成问题，通过 masked control interface 和 CVAE 行为潜空间实现多控制模式共享的 humanoid behavior prior。
zh.mainContent: 本文针对人形机器人全身控制中 task-specific policy 难以跨控制模式泛化的问题，提出 Behavior Foundation Model，将速度指令、VR 遥操作、运动跟踪等不同控制模式统一理解为对 humanoid behavior 的不同 specification。方法先通过 motion imitation 训练具备 privileged information 的 proxy agent，再用 masked online distillation 和 CVAE 将其行为知识蒸馏到可实机部署的生成式策略中。实验在 motion tracking、VR teleoperation、locomotion、behavior composition、behavior modulation 和 residual learning for new behaviors 上验证了 BFM 的泛化性和新行为快速适应能力，并在 Unitree G1 实机上进行了展示。
innovations: 提出将 humanoid WBC 从 task-specific control 转向统一 behavior learning 的视角，把不同控制模式看作对同一行为分布的不同条件约束。
设计 root control、kinematic position control 和 joint angle control 组成的统一 low-level control interface，并通过 bit-wise binary mask 支持不同控制模式及其任意组合。
采用 CVAE 建模条件行为分布，并通过 masked online distillation 从 proxy agent 中学习可复用行为先验；decoder 不直接输入 goal state，而是鼓励 latent variable 编码行为知识。
展示了 BFM latent space 的行为组合与调制能力，例如通过 latent interpolation 组合 root/keypoint 控制，通过类似 classifier-free guidance 的 latent extrapolation 改善高动态动作稳定性。
通过冻结 BFM 并训练 residual decoder，实现对 side salto 等新行为的高效获取，避免从零 RL 训练的低效探索。
implementation: 数据来源为 AMASS human motion dataset，动作由 SMPL 表示；论文采用两阶段 retargeting，将 SMPL 动作迁移到 humanoid robot，包括 rest pose 形状对齐和整段序列的 root/joint 优化。

proxy agent 使用 motion imitation 训练，输入 privileged proprioception 和 reference-derived goal state，输出目标关节位置 action；训练采用 PPO、RSI、early termination、hard negative mining、motion filtering、domain randomization 和 curriculum。
BFM 的 real-world proprioception 包含最近 25 步的关节位置、关节速度、root angular velocity、projected gravity 和历史动作；部署时不依赖仿真 privileged state。
BFM 使用 CVAE，包括 prior、encoder 和 decoder；训练时 encoder 使用 privileged simulation state 辅助推断 latent，部署时丢弃 encoder，仅使用 prior 和 decoder 输出动作。
BFM 预训练采用 DAgger-style online distillation：当前 BFM 在仿真中 rollout，随后查询 proxy agent 得到 reference action，并优化 action reconstruction loss 与 KL regularization。
实验在 IsaacGym 中使用 8192 个并行环境训练，并在 MuJoCo sim-to-sim 和 Unitree G1 真实机器人上展示部署；Unitree G1 原有 29 DoF，实验中冻结双手 wrist 后控制 23 DoF。

en.title: Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
en.authors: Weishuai Zeng, Shunlin Lu, Kangning Yin, Xiaojie Niu, Minyue Dai, Jingbo Wang, Jiangmiao Pang
en.institutions: Peking University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Fudan University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
en.takeaway: This paper reframes humanoid whole-body control as unified behavior generation and learns a reusable humanoid behavior prior through a masked control interface and a CVAE latent space.
en.mainContent: This paper addresses the lack of cross-task generalization in task-specific humanoid whole-body controllers by interpreting velocity commands, VR teleoperation signals, and motion tracking references as different specifications of humanoid behaviors. The method first trains a privileged proxy agent through motion imitation, then distills its behavioral knowledge into a deployable generative policy using masked online distillation and a CVAE. Experiments cover motion tracking, VR teleoperation, locomotion, behavior composition, behavior modulation, and residual learning for novel behaviors, with demonstrations in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
innovations: Reframes humanoid whole-body control from task-specific policy learning to unified behavior learning, where different control modes are treated as different conditional specifications of the same behavior distribution.

Introduces a unified low-level control interface composed of root control, kinematic position control, and joint angle control, with bit-wise binary masks enabling diverse control modes and arbitrary combinations.

Models the conditional behavior distribution with a CVAE and learns reusable behavior priors through masked online distillation from a privileged proxy agent; the decoder does not directly consume the goal state, encouraging the latent variable to encode behavioral knowledge.

Demonstrates behavior composition and modulation in the learned latent space, including latent interpolation across control modes and classifier-free-guidance-like latent extrapolation for stabilizing challenging behaviors.
Uses residual learning on top of a frozen pretrained BFM to efficiently acquire novel behaviors such as side salto, reducing inefficient exploration compared with RL from scratch.
implementation: The motion data comes from the AMASS human motion dataset parameterized by SMPL; the paper uses a two-stage retargeting pipeline to transfer SMPL motions to the humanoid, including rest-pose shape alignment and sequence-level optimization of root and joint states.

The proxy agent is trained by motion imitation with PPO. It takes privileged proprioception and reference-derived goal states as inputs and outputs target joint positions. The training uses RSI, early termination, hard negative mining, motion filtering, domain randomization, and curriculum learning.

The deployable BFM uses real-world proprioception consisting of a 25-step history of joint positions, joint velocities, root angular velocity, projected gravity, and previous actions, avoiding privileged simulation-only quantities at inference time.

The BFM is implemented as a CVAE with a prior, encoder, and decoder. The encoder uses privileged simulation states during training to infer latent variables, while only the prior and decoder are kept for deployment.

BFM pretraining follows DAgger-style online distillation: the current BFM is rolled out in simulation, the proxy agent is queried for reference actions, and the model is optimized using action reconstruction loss plus KL regularization.

Training is conducted in IsaacGym with 8192 parallel environments, and the paper reports IsaacGym metrics while also showing MuJoCo sim-to-sim and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid. The original 29-DoF robot is simplified to 23 DoF by freezing both wrists.

zh.title: Making Tracking Easy: Neural Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Whole-body Control
zh.authors: Qingrui Zhao, Kaiyue Yang, Xiyu Wang, Shiqi Zhao, Yi Lu, Xinfang Zhang, Qiu Shen, Xiao-Xiao Long, Xun Cao
zh.institutions: Nanjing University; Huawei Technologies
zh.takeaway: 这篇论文用昂贵的仿真 RL 离线生成物理可执行标签，再把这种“物理修正能力”蒸馏进一个快速神经重定向网络，从而让下游全身 tracking policy 更容易训练和跟踪。
zh.mainContent: 本文真正解决的不是“人体动作能不能几何映射到机器人”，而是“映射后的机器人参考动作是否容易被控制器稳定跟踪”。传统 GMR / IK 主要做几何匹配，容易产生局部最优、关节跳变、自碰撞、撞限位和脚滑，使后续 tracking policy 被迫学习额外补偿。NMR 的关键在 CEPR：先用 GMR 生成粗标签，再用分簇 RL expert 在物理仿真中追踪并修复这些动作，把实际 rollout 状态保存为物理修正后的标签，最后监督训练序列重定向网络将这种修正能力蒸馏出来。实验表明，NMR 生成的参考轨迹更平滑、更少碰撞和限位问题，并能提升下游 whole-body tracking policy 的训练效率和跟踪表现。
innovations: 从 Hessian 角度分析传统优化式 retargeting 的非凸性，指出局部最优、关节跳变和自碰撞并非单纯调参问题，而是几何优化目标本身的结构性风险。
核心创新在 CEPR 数据构造管线：GMR 先生成粗糙机器人动作，分簇 RL expert 再作为离线数据清洗器和标注器，在物理仿真中追踪并修复这些动作，保存实际 rollout 轨迹作为物理一致标签。
将“GMR 粗标签 → RL expert 物理修复 → NMR 蒸馏”组织成高质量数据构建 pipeline，把昂贵的仿真 RL 计算转化为可复用的监督学习训练数据。
提出基于 CNN-Transformer 的序列重定向网络，输入整段 SMPL 动作，输出整段 Unitree G1 参考运动；网络本身更像监督学习的快速 retargeter，而不是新的 PPO 或 Transformer 理论贡献。
采用两阶段训练策略：先用大规模 GMR/kinematic retargeting 数据预训练学习人到机器人的基础对应，再用 CEPR 物理一致数据微调以输出更平滑、更少碰撞、更少撞限位的参考轨迹。
implementation: 输入为 SMPL human motion sequence，人体动作表示包含 root 在 XZ 平面的线速度、root 6D rotation、局部关节位置和局部关节速度；输出为 humanoid motion sequence，额外包含机器人 actuated joint DoFs。
CEPR 首先过滤 excessive jerk、CoM 远离支撑区域、足地接触不足、漂浮和穿地等异常人体动作；随后使用 GMR 生成初始机器人动作，并根据关节速度、自碰撞比例和足端漂浮高度等阈值过滤异常片段。
CEPR 使用 motion latent feature 对动作进行聚类，并为每个 cluster 训练 RL expert tracking policy；expert policy 的 observation 包括 reference motion state、robot proprioception 和 previous action，总维度为 509。

RL expert policy 使用 PPO 和 symmetric actor-critic 框架训练，奖励主要由 anchor/body link 的位置、姿态、线速度、角速度 tracking reward 构成，并加入 action rate 与 undesired contacts penalty；训练中使用 adaptive standard deviation schedule 逐步提高 tracking 精度。
CEPR 中的 RL expert 和最终部署用的 tracking policy 是两回事：expert 只在离线阶段用于物理修复、数据清洗和生成监督标签，最终部署流程是 SMPL → NMR → 机器人参考轨迹 → 底层 tracking policy → 真机。
NMR 网络结构包括 1D Conv / ResNet encoder、Bi-directional Transformer、Upsample 和 1D Conv decoder；由于 human 与 humanoid motion 在时间上严格一一对应，网络使用 full self-attention 而非 causal attention。
NMR 使用 L1 loss 监督训练：先在大规模 kinematic retargeting 数据上用 AdamW 训练 500 epochs，batch size 为 128，初始学习率为 2e-4；再在约 30K CEPR 物理一致数据上以 1e-5 学习率微调 50 epochs。
实验在 Unitree G1 humanoid 上进行，测试集来自 AMASS，包含 82 条 motion sequences、约 119K frames；对比方法包括 GMR、PHUMA、NMR w/o RL 和完整 NMR。
论文报告 NMR 在 retargeting quality 上实现 0 joint jumps、0.87% self-collision frames 和 16.80% joint-limit frames，并在下游 BeyondMimic-style tracking policy 训练中带来更高 reward、更长 episode length 和更低 MPJPE/W-MPJPE。

en.title: Making Tracking Easy: Neural Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Whole-body Control
en.authors: Qingrui Zhao, Kaiyue Yang, Xiyu Wang, Shiqi Zhao, Yi Lu, Xinfang Zhang, Qiu Shen, Xiao-Xiao Long, Xun Cao
en.institutions: Nanjing University; Huawei Technologies
en.takeaway: This paper uses expensive simulation RL offline to generate physically executable labels, then distills that physical correction capability into a fast neural retargeting network so downstream whole-body tracking policies are easier to train and track.
en.mainContent: The real issue addressed by this paper is not whether human motion can be geometrically mapped to a robot, but whether the mapped robot reference is easy for a controller to track. Traditional GMR / IK mainly performs geometric matching and can produce local minima, joint jumps, self-collisions, joint-limit violations, and foot skating, forcing the downstream tracking policy to compensate for bad references. NMR's key contribution is CEPR: GMR first produces rough robot labels, clustered RL experts then track and physically repair those motions in simulation, and the resulting rollout states are saved as physically corrected labels for supervised distillation. Experiments show that NMR produces smoother and more feasible references, improving downstream whole-body tracking training and tracking quality.
innovations: Provides a Hessian-based analysis showing that optimization-based retargeting is generally non-convex, explaining why local minima, joint discontinuities, and self-collisions can occur structurally rather than merely due to poor tuning.

Centers the contribution on CEPR data construction: GMR generates rough robot motions, clustered RL experts act as offline data cleaners and labelers, and their physical rollouts become corrected supervision labels.
Organizes the system as GMR rough labels → RL expert physical repair → NMR distillation, turning expensive simulation RL into reusable supervised training data.

Uses a CNN-Transformer sequence retargeting network that maps a full SMPL motion sequence to a full Unitree G1 reference sequence; the network is best understood as a fast supervised retargeter rather than a new PPO or Transformer theory contribution.

Uses two-stage training: large-scale GMR / kinematic pretraining for broad human-to-robot correspondence, followed by CEPR fine-tuning for smoother, less colliding, and less joint-limit-violating references.
implementation: The input is an SMPL human motion sequence represented by root linear velocities on the XZ plane, root 6D rotation, local joint positions, and local joint velocities; the output is a humanoid motion sequence with additional robot actuated joint DoFs.

CEPR first filters abnormal human motions such as excessive jerk, CoM far outside the support base, insufficient foot-ground contact, floating, and penetration; it then applies GMR for initial robot retargeting and filters segments using joint velocity, self-collision ratio, and foot floating thresholds.

CEPR clusters motions using latent motion features and trains one RL expert tracking policy for each cluster; the expert policy observation includes reference motion state, robot proprioception, and previous action, with a total dimension of 509.

The RL expert policies are trained with PPO and a symmetric actor-critic framework. Rewards are mainly tracking terms for anchor/body link position, orientation, linear velocity, and angular velocity, with penalties for action rate and undesired contacts. An adaptive standard deviation schedule is used to progressively tighten tracking precision.

The CEPR RL experts are not the final deployment tracking policy. They are used only offline for physical repair, data cleaning, and supervised label generation. The deployment pipeline is SMPL → NMR → robot reference trajectory → low-level tracking policy → real robot.

The NMR architecture consists of 1D Conv / ResNet encoding, a bidirectional Transformer, and Upsample / 1D Conv decoding. Since human and humanoid motions are temporally aligned, it uses full self-attention rather than causal attention.

NMR is trained with an L1 regression loss. It is first pretrained on large-scale kinematic retargeting data for 500 epochs with AdamW, batch size 128, and learning rate 2e-4, and then fine-tuned on about 30K CEPR-refined motion pairs for 50 epochs with learning rate 1e-5.
Experiments are conducted on the Unitree G1 humanoid using an AMASS test suite with 82 motion sequences and about 119K frames. Baselines include GMR, PHUMA, NMR without RL fine-tuning, and full NMR.

The paper reports that NMR achieves 0 joint jumps, 0.87% self-collision frames, and 16.80% joint-limit frames, and improves downstream BeyondMimic-style tracking policy training in terms of reward, episode length, MPJPE, and W-MPJPE.

zh.title: TRAM: Global Trajectory and Motion of 3D Humans from in-the-wild Videos
zh.authors: Yufu Wang, Ziyun Wang, Lingjie Liu, Kostas Daniilidis
zh.institutions: University of Pennsylvania; Archimedes, Athena RC
zh.takeaway: TRAM 最值得记住的是：它不从人体运动先验中猜全局位移，而是先用背景恢复 metric-scale 相机轨迹，再把相机系 SMPL 人体运动变换到世界坐标系。
zh.mainContent: 本文研究如何从真实场景、移动相机拍摄的单目视频中恢复三维人体的完整世界空间运动，包括全局 root trajectory 和局部 SMPL body motion。TRAM 采用两阶段框架：先通过 Masked DROID-SLAM 从背景恢复鲁棒的相机轨迹，并利用 ZoeDepth 的 metric depth 估计轨迹尺度；再用视频 Transformer 模型 VIMO 回归相机坐标系下的人体 SMPL 运动。最后将 metric-scale camera motion 与 camera-frame human motion 组合，得到世界坐标系下的人体全局轨迹和运动。实验显示，TRAM 在 EMDB 上显著降低全局人体轨迹误差，并且 VIMO 在人体 pose/shape 重建和运动平滑性上优于多种 baseline。
innovations: 提出 scene-centric 的全局人体运动恢复思路：不依赖 MoCap locomotion prior 估计人体全局轨迹，而是从背景中恢复 metric-scale camera trajectory，再与相机系人体运动组合。
提出 Masked DROID-SLAM：同时 mask 输入图像中的动态人体区域和 dense bundle adjustment 中的人体区域置信度，使 SLAM 主要依赖静态背景像素，提升移动人体场景下的相机轨迹鲁棒性。
提出基于背景 metric depth 的轨迹尺度估计：用 ZoeDepth 预测关键帧深度，并通过鲁棒优化和全轨迹 median 估计单目 SLAM 的尺度，而不是直接把预测深度作为 RGB-D SLAM 输入。
提出 VIMO：在 HMR2.0 基础上加入两个 temporal transformer，一个在 image patch token 域传播时序信息，另一个在 SMPL pose motion 域学习运动平滑和去噪。
implementation: 输入为 in-the-wild 单目视频；输出包括 metric-scale camera trajectory、相机坐标系下的人体 root pose、SMPL 局部姿态和形状参数，以及组合后的世界坐标系人体 root trajectory。
人体模型采用 SMPL，局部身体运动表示为 Θ_t={θ_t,β_t}，人体相对相机的 root 位姿表示为 T_t={r_t,π_t}；世界坐标系人体轨迹通过 H_t=G_t∘T_t 得到，其中 G_t 是相机在世界坐标系中的位姿。
相机轨迹恢复使用 DROID-SLAM，并通过 YOLOv7 检测人体、Segment Anything 生成 mask；mask 同时作用于输入图像和 DROID-SLAM 的 dense bundle adjustment confidence。
尺度估计使用 ZoeDepth 预测关键帧 metric depth，将 DROID-SLAM 的任意尺度深度 d_i 与 metric depth D_i 对齐，优化尺度 α，并对所有关键帧尺度取 median。
VIMO 建立在 HMR2.0 之上，冻结 ViT-Huge backbone，只微调两个 temporal transformer 和原 transformer decoder；训练使用 3DPW、Human3.6M 和 BEDLAM。
VIMO 训练 100K iterations，优化器为 AdamW，weight decay 为 0.01，batch size 为 24 个 16 帧序列；transformer decoder 学习率为 1e-5，两个 temporal transformer 学习率为 3e-5。
论文未说明完整端到端推理速度，也未给出实时部署结果；从模型组成看，该方法更偏离线视频处理。

en.title: TRAM: Global Trajectory and Motion of 3D Humans from in-the-wild Videos
en.authors: Yufu Wang, Ziyun Wang, Lingjie Liu, Kostas Daniilidis
en.institutions: University of Pennsylvania; Archimedes, Athena RC
en.takeaway: TRAM should be remembered as a scene-centric pipeline that recovers metric-scale camera motion from the background and composes it with camera-frame SMPL motion to obtain world-space human motion.
en.mainContent: This paper studies how to recover complete 3D human motion from in-the-wild monocular videos captured by a moving camera, including the global root trajectory and local SMPL body motion. TRAM uses a two-stage pipeline: it first robustifies monocular SLAM with dynamic-human masking and estimates metric scale from background depth, then uses a video transformer model called VIMO to regress camera-frame SMPL motion. The recovered metric camera trajectory and camera-frame human motion are composed to produce world-space human trajectory and motion. Experiments on EMDB show large reductions in global motion error, while VIMO improves pose/shape reconstruction accuracy and temporal smoothness over strong baselines.
innovations: A scene-centric formulation for global human motion recovery: the method estimates metric-scale camera trajectory from the background instead of inferring global human displacement from a learned MoCap locomotion prior.
Masked DROID-SLAM: dynamic human regions are masked both in the input images and in the dense bundle adjustment confidence, forcing SLAM to rely on static background pixels.
A robust metric-scale estimation procedure that aligns DROID-SLAM depth with ZoeDepth metric depth using robust optimization and aggregates keyframe scale estimates with the median.

VIMO, a video transformer model built on HMR2.0 with two temporal transformers: one propagates temporal information over image patch tokens, and the other denoises and smooths motion directly in the SMPL pose domain.
implementation: The input is an in-the-wild monocular video. The outputs include metric-scale camera trajectory, camera-frame human root pose, SMPL local pose and shape parameters, and the composed world-frame human root trajectory.

The human body is represented by SMPL. Local body motion is Θ_t={θ_t,β_t}, the human root pose relative to the camera is T_t={r_t,π_t}, and the world-space human trajectory is computed as H_t=G_t∘T_t, where G_t is the camera pose in the world frame.

Camera trajectory is recovered with DROID-SLAM. Human masks are obtained using YOLOv7 detections as prompts for Segment Anything, and the masks are applied to both the input images and the dense bundle adjustment confidence.
Metric scale is estimated by aligning DROID-SLAM depth d_i with ZoeDepth metric depth D_i for keyframes, optimizing a scale α with a robust loss, and taking the median over all keyframes.
VIMO builds on HMR2.0, freezes the ViT-Huge backbone, and finetunes two temporal transformers together with the original transformer decoder. It is trained on 3DPW, Human3.6M, and BEDLAM.

VIMO is trained for 100K iterations with AdamW, weight decay 0.01, a batch size of 24 sequences, and 16 frames per sequence. The learning rate is 1e-5 for the transformer decoder and 3e-5 for the two temporal transformers.
The paper does not report full end-to-end runtime or real-time deployment results; based on the pipeline components, the method is better understood as an offline video processing system.

zh.title: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills
zh.authors: Tairan He, Jiawei Gao, Wenli Xiao, Yuanhang Zhang, Zi Wang, Jiashun Wang, Zhengyi Luo, Guanqi He, Nikhil Sobanbabu, Chaoyi Pan, Zeji Yi, Guannan Qu, Kris Kitani, Jessica Hodgins, Linxi “Jim” Fan, Yuke Zhu, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi
zh.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University; NVIDIA
zh.takeaway: 用真实 rollout 学一个 delta action model 来把仿真动力学对齐到真实机器人，再在对齐后的仿真中微调策略，是敏捷人形机器人 sim-to-real 的一条很有代表性的 real-to-sim-to-real 路线。
zh.mainContent: 这篇论文面向人形机器人敏捷全身技能的 sim-to-real 问题，核心挑战是仿真动力学与真实机器人之间的 mismatch 会导致高动态动作在真机上退化。ASAP 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段从人类视频中重建 SMPL 动作，经物理清洗与重定向得到 Unitree G1 参考轨迹，并训练 phase-based motion tracking policy；第二阶段在真实 G1 上采集 rollout，训练 delta action model 来补偿仿真与真实状态转移之间的偏差。作者将冻结的 delta action model 嵌入仿真器形成 aligned simulation physics，再微调原策略，最终在真实部署时只使用微调后的 policy，不使用 delta action model。实验覆盖 IsaacGym→IsaacSim、IsaacGym→Genesis 和 IsaacGym→真实 Unitree G1，结果显示 ASAP 相比 SysID、domain randomization 和 delta dynamics baseline 降低 tracking error，并提升敏捷全身动作的真机执行质量。
innovations: 提出用 action-space residual / delta action model 对齐仿真与真实物理，而不是只依赖显式 SysID 参数搜索、domain randomization 或直接学习 state residual dynamics。
把 delta action model 作为训练环境对齐器：训练时嵌入仿真器形成 aligned simulation physics，微调 motion tracking policy；真实部署时直接部署微调后的 policy，不额外运行 delta action model。
构建从人类视频到真机人形技能的完整 pipeline：TRAM 重建 SMPL 运动，MaskedMimic 做 simulation-based data cleaning，human-to-humanoid retargeting 生成 G1 参考轨迹，再训练 phase-conditioned tracking policy。
在高动态 Unitree G1 全身动作上验证 sim-to-real，对比 SysID、DeltaDynamics、Vanilla 等 baseline，并分析 dataset size、training horizon、action norm、随机 action noise 等因素。
implementation: 预训练阶段：输入人类视频；TRAM 输出 SMPL 格式的 global root translation、orientation、body poses 和 shape parameters；MaskedMimic 在 IsaacGym 中模仿并过滤不物理可行的 SMPL 动作；再通过 shape-and-motion two-stage retargeting 得到 G1 机器人轨迹数据。

motion tracking policy：使用 PPO 训练 phase-based policy，actor 输入为本体历史和 phase；本体历史包括 5-step joint position、joint velocity、root angular velocity、root projected gravity 和历史 action；action 为 23-DoF target joint positions，并交给 PD controller 执行。

post-training 数据采集：把预训练 policy 部署到真实 Unitree G1，记录真实 rollout。论文记录的状态为 base 3D position、base linear velocity、base orientation quaternion、base angular velocity、23-DoF joint position 和 joint velocity；这些信息由 MoCap 与 onboard sensors 共同获得。

delta action learning：训练 \(\Delta a_t = \pi_\theta^\Delta(s_t,a_t)\)，在仿真中执行 \(a_t^r + \Delta a_t\)，目标是让 simulated next state 接近真实记录的 next state；训练使用 PPO 和状态跟踪 reward、action norm / action rate regularization、DoF / torque limit penalty 等。

policy fine-tuning 与部署：冻结 delta action model，将仿真器改为 \(f^{ASAP}(s_t,a_t)=f^{sim}(s_t,a_t+\pi^\Delta(s_t,a_t))\)，用原 motion tracking reward 微调 policy；最终真实部署时不使用 delta action model，只部署微调后的 tracking policy。
真实实验：由于高动态数据采集导致电机过热和硬件损坏风险，论文没有训练完整 23-DoF delta action model，而是聚焦 G1 脚踝 4-DoF delta action model；真实数据包含 100 个 motion clips，并对每个任务执行 30 次，另采集 10 分钟 locomotion data 用于 policy transition。

en.title: ASAP: Aligning Simulation and Real-World Physics for Learning Agile Humanoid Whole-Body Skills
en.authors: Tairan He, Jiawei Gao, Wenli Xiao, Yuanhang Zhang, Zi Wang, Jiashun Wang, Zhengyi Luo, Guanqi He, Nikhil Sobanbabu, Chaoyi Pan, Zeji Yi, Guannan Qu, Kris Kitani, Jessica Hodgins, Linxi “Jim” Fan, Yuke Zhu, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi
en.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University; NVIDIA
en.takeaway: ASAP is a representative real-to-sim-to-real pipeline: learn a delta action model from real rollouts to align simulator dynamics, fine-tune the policy in the aligned simulator, and deploy only the fine-tuned policy on the real humanoid.
en.mainContent: This paper studies sim-to-real transfer for agile humanoid whole-body skills, where dynamics mismatch between simulation and the real robot causes high-dynamic motions to degrade on hardware. ASAP uses a two-stage framework: it first pre-trains a phase-based motion tracking policy from human-video-derived and retargeted G1 motions, then collects real-world rollouts to train a delta action model that compensates for the discrepancy between simulated and real state transitions. The learned delta action model is frozen and integrated into the simulator as aligned simulation physics for policy fine-tuning; at deployment, only the fine-tuned policy is used. Experiments cover IsaacGym-to-IsaacSim, IsaacGym-to-Genesis, and IsaacGym-to-real Unitree G1 transfer, showing lower tracking error and better agile whole-body coordination than SysID, domain randomization, and delta dynamics baselines.
innovations: Introduces action-space residual learning via a delta action model to align simulator and real-world physics, instead of relying only on explicit SysID parameter search, domain randomization, or state-residual dynamics learning.
Uses the delta action model as a training-time simulator aligner: it is embedded into the simulator for policy fine-tuning, while real-world deployment runs only the fine-tuned policy.

Builds an end-to-end human-video-to-humanoid-skill pipeline: TRAM reconstructs SMPL motions, MaskedMimic performs simulation-based data cleaning, human-to-humanoid retargeting generates G1 reference trajectories, and a phase-conditioned tracking policy is trained.
Validates the approach on dynamic Unitree G1 whole-body motions and analyzes key design factors including dataset size, training horizon, action norm, and random action noise fine-tuning.
implementation: Pre-training data pipeline: input human videos; TRAM estimates SMPL-format global root translation, orientation, body poses, and shape parameters; MaskedMimic tracks and filters physically infeasible SMPL motions in IsaacGym; a two-stage shape-and-motion retargeting process produces Unitree G1 robot trajectories.

Motion tracking policy: trained with PPO as a phase-based policy. The actor uses proprioceptive history and phase; proprioception includes 5-step histories of joint positions, joint velocities, root angular velocity, root projected gravity, and previous actions. The action is a 23-DoF target joint-position command passed to a PD controller.

Post-training data collection: the pre-trained policy is deployed on a real Unitree G1 and real rollouts are recorded. The recorded state includes base 3D position, base linear velocity, base orientation quaternion, base angular velocity, 23-DoF joint positions, and joint velocities, obtained from a MoCap device and onboard sensors.

Delta action learning: train \(\Delta a_t = \pi_\theta^\Delta(s_t,a_t)\). In simulation, execute \(a_t^r + \Delta a_t\) so the simulated next state matches the recorded real next state. PPO is used with state-tracking rewards, action norm / action rate regularization, and DoF / torque-limit penalties.

Policy fine-tuning and deployment: freeze the delta action model and use \(f^{ASAP}(s_t,a_t)=f^{sim}(s_t,a_t+\pi^\Delta(s_t,a_t))\) as the aligned simulator, then fine-tune the original tracking policy with the same motion-tracking reward. The final real-world deployment does not use the delta action model.

Real-world experiment detail: because high-dynamic data collection overheats motors and risks hardware damage, the paper does not train a full 23-DoF real-world delta action model; it trains a 4-DoF ankle delta action model for G1. The real-world dataset contains 100 motion clips, with 30 executions per task, plus 10 minutes of locomotion data for policy transition.

zh.title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
zh.authors: Zhengyi Luo, Ye Yuan, Tingwu Wang, Chenran Li, Sirui Chen, Fernando Castañeda, Zi-Ang Cao, Jiefeng Li, David Minor, Qingwei Ben, Xingye Da, Runyu Ding, Cyrus Hogg, Lina Song, Edy Lim, Eugene Jeong, Tairan He, Haoru Xue, Wenli Xiao, Zi Wang, Simon Yuen, Jan Kautz, Yan Chang, Umar Iqbal, Linxi Jim Fan, Yuke Zhu
zh.institutions: NVIDIA
zh.takeaway: 这篇论文最值得记住的是：把大规模 motion tracking 作为 humanoid foundation control 的底座，用 mocap 数据、PPO 物理跟踪、universal token 和 kinematic planner 让同一个人形机器人策略支持自然全身控制、遥操作、多模态输入和 VLA 接入。
zh.mainContent: SONIC 研究如何将人形机器人控制从小规模、任务特定的 reward engineering 推向可扩展的基础控制模型。论文将 motion tracking 设定为可规模化基础任务，用 100M+ 帧、约 700 小时的人体动作捕捉数据训练一个通用 whole-body tracking policy，并沿模型规模、数据规模和计算量三个维度验证 scaling trend。方法上，SONIC 使用 PPO 在物理仿真中训练闭环 tracking policy，同时通过 robot/human/hybrid 三类 encoder、FSQ quantizer、robot control decoder 和 robot motion decoder 构造 universal token space。论文还引入实时 generative kinematic motion planner，把用户速度、方向、风格、蹲下、爬行、拳击等意图转成短时 kinematic reference，并在 Unitree G1 上展示 motion tracking、VR teleoperation、video/text/music control 与 VLA apple-to-plate proof-of-concept。
innovations: 将 motion tracking 明确提出为人形机器人控制的 scalable foundational task：相比为每个技能单独设计 reward，利用大规模 mocap 提供逐帧 dense supervision 来学习 human motion prior。
从数据、模型和算力三条轴扩展 humanoid tracking：论文报告使用 100M+ motion frames、约 700 小时高质量动作数据，并将网络规模扩到约 42M 参数；实验显示更大数据、模型和计算量能持续改善 tracking 性能。
提出 universal token space：robot motion、human motion 和 hybrid motion 分别经专门 MLP encoder 编码，再经 FSQ quantizer 得到 shared latent token，由同一个 robot control decoder 输出机器人控制命令。
底层 universal tracking policy 采用 single-stage training without distillation：PPO tracking loss 与 reconstruction loss、token alignment loss、cycle consistency loss 共同优化 encoder、quantizer 和 decoder。
提出 real-time generative kinematic motion planner：planner 是训练在同一 motion 数据上的 latent generative model，在 latent token 空间中做 autoregressive / masked-token motion in-betweening，用于把用户意图转成短时机器人参考动作。
展示同一 policy 可接入多种接口：interactive gamepad control、VR 3-point teleoperation、VR whole-body teleoperation、human video teleoperation、text/music motion generation 和 VLA foundation model。
在 Unitree G1 上展示 sim-to-real：论文报告 unseen AMASS 测试集上 SONIC 的 tracking success rate 为 99.6%，并在 50 条真实机器人 motion trajectories 上实现 100% success；VLA apple-to-plate proof-of-concept 为 20 次试验 95% success。
implementation: 数据：论文使用由 170 名人类受试者组成的大规模 mocap corpus，身高范围 145-199 cm，覆盖 locomotion、daily activities、gesturing、combat motions 等，clip 长度 1-180 s，总计约 700 小时、100M+ frames at 50 Hz；human motion retargeting 适配自 GMR 和 PyRoki。

MDP 与 RL：humanoid motion tracking 被建模为 MDP，状态由 proprioception 和 motion command 组成；proprioception 包括 joint pose、joint velocity、root angular velocity、root frame gravity vector 和 previous action；motion command 包括 robot motion g_r、human motion g_h 或 hybrid motion g_m。策略用 PPO 训练，输出 29 维 target joint positions，并由各关节 PD controller 跟踪。

Reward：tracking reward 包括 root orientation、body link relative position、body link relative orientation、body link linear velocity、body link angular velocity；penalty 包括 action rate、joint limit violation 和 undesired contacts。论文未给出 formal stability proof，稳定性主要依赖物理仿真 RL、domain randomization 和实证验证。

Universal policy 网络：robot motion encoder、human motion encoder、hybrid motion encoder 均为 MLP hidden=[2048,1024,512,512]；FSQ quantizer 产生 universal token；robot control/action decoder 为 MLP hidden=[4096,4096,2048,2048,1024,1024,512,512]；auxiliary robot motion/ref decoder 为 MLP hidden=[2048,1024,512,512]；critic 也是大 MLP。论文未说明 universal token 的具体 D_z 与 L_z 数值。

Training loss：总损失为 L = L_ppo + L_recon + L_token + L_cycle。L_recon 要求 robot/human/hybrid token 都能通过 robot motion decoder 重构 robot motion command；L_token 对齐 robot token 与 human token；L_cycle 约束 human token 经 robot motion decoder 再由 robot encoder 编回后接近 robot token。

PPO 超参数：每 GPU 4096 parallel envs、每环境 24 steps、learning epochs=5、mini-batches=4、gamma=0.99、GAE lambda=0.95、clip=0.2、entropy coefficient=0.013、actor learning rate=2e-5、critic learning rate=1e-3、max grad norm=0.1、desired KL=0.01。

Domain randomization：训练中随机化静/动摩擦、restitution、default joint positions、base COM offset，并施加 root linear/angular velocity perturbations；还对 target motion command 加 position/orientation/velocity/joint jitter 以增强 sim-to-real 鲁棒性。
Adaptive sampling：motion dataset 被划分成固定时长 bins，按每个 bin 的 failure rate 进行 capped hard-example sampling，并与 uniform sampling 混合；论文给出 bin size=1s、failure rate cap beta=200、blending alpha=0.1。

Kinematic planner：planner 不是 PPO 训练的控制器，而是在同一大规模 whole-body motion data 上训练的 latent generative model。训练时采样 0.8-2.4s motion segments，取两端 keyframes 作为 context 和 target，motion representation 使用 pelvis-relative joint positions 和 global joint rotations，并随机旋转训练样本。

Planner token：连续 motion 先编码为 latent token sequence，downsampling rate=4；planner 在 token space 中使用 masked token prediction，训练时 mask ratio 从 [100%,0%] 均匀采样，推理时用 cosine schedule 逐步 finalize 高置信 token。论文说 latent token sequence 可由 Transformer 或 Conv1D 捕捉 temporal consistency，但论文未说明最终 backbone 是 Transformer 还是 Conv1D，也未明确给出 planner 的完整 loss 公式。

部署：真实机器人为 Unitree G1，policy loop 50 Hz，kinematic planner 10 Hz，低层 joint target 通过 Unitree low-level API 以 500 Hz 持续发布，user input 100 Hz；Jetson Orin 上 policy forward pass 约 1-2 ms，motion generation 约 12 ms，使用 TensorRT 与 CUDA Graph 加速。
局限：论文讨论中明确提到 safety、compliance、energy efficiency、noisy input handling 仍是局限；还把 planner、tokenizer 和 policy 的 joint training 列为未来工作，说明当前 planner/GENMO/VLA 并非与 PPO tracking policy 完整端到端联合训练。

en.title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
en.authors: Zhengyi Luo, Ye Yuan, Tingwu Wang, Chenran Li, Sirui Chen, Fernando Castañeda, Zi-Ang Cao, Jiefeng Li, David Minor, Qingwei Ben, Xingye Da, Runyu Ding, Cyrus Hogg, Lina Song, Edy Lim, Eugene Jeong, Tairan He, Haoru Xue, Wenli Xiao, Zi Wang, Simon Yuen, Jan Kautz, Yan Chang, Umar Iqbal, Linxi Jim Fan, Yuke Zhu
en.institutions: NVIDIA
en.takeaway: SONIC is worth remembering as a large-scale humanoid motion-tracking foundation controller: it combines massive mocap data, PPO-based physical tracking, a universal token space, and a kinematic planner so that one humanoid policy can support natural whole-body control, teleoperation, multimodal inputs, and VLA integration.
en.mainContent: SONIC studies whether humanoid whole-body control can scale beyond small task-specific policies and reward-engineered skills. It casts motion tracking as a scalable foundation task and trains on 100M+ frames, roughly 700 hours, of high-quality human motion-capture data while scaling model size, dataset size, and compute. Methodologically, SONIC trains a PPO-based closed-loop tracking policy and builds a universal token space through robot, human, and hybrid encoders, an FSQ quantizer, a robot control decoder, and an auxiliary robot motion decoder. It further introduces a real-time generative kinematic motion planner that converts user intent into short-horizon motion references, enabling demonstrations on Unitree G1 across tracking, VR teleoperation, video/text/music control, and a VLA apple-to-plate proof of concept.
innovations: It identifies motion tracking as a scalable foundational task for humanoid control, using dense frame-level supervision from motion capture instead of designing a new task reward for every behavior.

It scales humanoid tracking along data, model, and compute axes, reporting 100M+ motion frames, around 700 hours of motion data, and a model scaled up to around 42M parameters; experiments show consistent gains from scaling.
It introduces a universal token space in which robot motion, human motion, and hybrid motion are encoded by specialized MLP encoders, quantized by FSQ, and decoded by a shared robot control decoder.
The universal tracking policy is trained in a single stage without distillation, combining PPO tracking loss with reconstruction, token-alignment, and cycle-consistency losses.

It proposes a real-time generative kinematic motion planner, trained on the same motion data, that performs autoregressive / masked-token motion in-betweening in latent space to convert user commands into short-horizon robot motion references.

It shows that the same policy can interface with gamepad control, VR 3-point teleoperation, VR whole-body teleoperation, human video teleoperation, text/music motion generation, and VLA foundation models.

It reports strong empirical results on Unitree G1: 99.6% tracking success on an unseen AMASS subset, 100% success on 50 real-world motion trajectories, and 95% success over 20 trials in a VLA apple-to-plate proof-of-concept task.
implementation: Data: the paper uses a large-scale motion-capture corpus from 170 human subjects, covering locomotion, daily activities, gesturing, and combat motions. Clips last from 1 to 180 seconds, totaling around 700 hours and 100M+ frames at 50 Hz. Human-to-robot retargeting is adapted from GMR and PyRoki.

MDP and RL: humanoid tracking is formulated as an MDP. The state combines proprioception and motion commands. Proprioception includes joint pose, joint velocity, root angular velocity, gravity vector in the root frame, and previous action. The motion command can be robot motion g_r, human motion g_h, or hybrid motion g_m. The PPO policy outputs 29-dimensional target joint positions tracked by joint-level PD controllers.

Reward: the tracking reward includes root orientation, body-link relative position, body-link relative orientation, body-link linear velocity, and body-link angular velocity. Penalties include action-rate penalty, joint-limit violation, and undesired contacts. The paper does not provide a formal stability proof; robustness is mainly empirical and supported by simulation training, domain randomization, and real-robot deployment.

Universal policy architecture: robot, human, and hybrid motion encoders are MLPs with hidden layers [2048,1024,512,512]. The FSQ quantizer produces the universal token. The robot control/action decoder is an MLP with hidden layers [4096,4096,2048,2048,1024,1024,512,512]. The auxiliary robot motion/reference decoder is an MLP with hidden layers [2048,1024,512,512]. The critic is also a large MLP. The exact D_z and L_z values for the universal token are not specified in the paper.

Training loss: the total objective is L = L_ppo + L_recon + L_token + L_cycle. L_recon reconstructs robot motion commands from robot, human, and hybrid tokens. L_token aligns robot and human tokens. L_cycle enforces consistency after decoding a human token into robot motion and re-encoding it with the robot encoder.

PPO hyperparameters: 4096 parallel environments per GPU, 24 steps per environment, 5 learning epochs, 4 mini-batches, gamma=0.99, GAE lambda=0.95, PPO clip=0.2, entropy coefficient=0.013, actor learning rate=2e-5, critic learning rate=1e-3, max gradient norm=0.1, and desired KL=0.01.

Domain randomization: training randomizes static and dynamic friction, restitution, default joint positions, base COM offset, root linear/angular velocity perturbations, and target motion perturbations including position, orientation, velocity, angular velocity, and joint jitter.

Adaptive sampling: the motion dataset is partitioned into fixed-duration bins. Sampling is biased toward bins with higher failure rates while being blended with uniform sampling. The paper reports bin size=1s, failure-rate cap beta=200, and blending alpha=0.1.

Kinematic planner: the planner is not a PPO-trained controller. It is a latent generative model trained on the same whole-body motion data. During training, it samples 0.8-2.4s motion segments, uses endpoint keyframes as context and target conditions, represents motion with pelvis-relative joint positions and global joint rotations, and randomly rotates samples for orientation robustness.

Planner token modeling: continuous motion is encoded into a latent token sequence with downsampling rate 4. The planner performs masked token prediction in token space. During training, the mask ratio is uniformly sampled from [100%,0%]. During inference, a cosine schedule finalizes high-confidence tokens. The paper states that the latent token sequence can be modeled by Transformers or Conv1D networks, but it does not specify which backbone was ultimately used, nor does it explicitly provide the full planner loss formula.

Deployment: experiments run on a Unitree G1. The policy loop runs at 50 Hz, the kinematic planner at 10 Hz, joint targets are streamed through the Unitree low-level API at 500 Hz, and user input is captured at 100 Hz. On Jetson Orin, policy inference takes about 1-2 ms and motion generation about 12 ms, using TensorRT and CUDA Graph acceleration.

Limitations: the paper explicitly notes open issues in formal safety, compliance, energy efficiency, and noisy input handling. It also lists joint training of planner, tokenizer, and policy as future work, indicating that the planner, GENMO, VLA, and PPO tracking policy are not currently trained as one fully end-to-end system.

zh.title: OmniRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Data Generation for Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation and Scene Interaction
zh.authors: Lujie Yang, Xiaoyu Huang, Zhen Wu, Angjoo Kanazawa, Pieter Abbeel, Carmelo Sferrazza, C. Karen Liu, Rocky Duan, Guanya Shi
zh.institutions: Amazon FAR; MIT; UC Berkeley; Stanford University; CMU
zh.takeaway: 这篇论文最值得记住的是：复杂人形 loco-manipulation 的难点不只在 RL 奖励设计，而在于先生成高质量、交互保持、满足运动学硬约束的机器人参考轨迹。
zh.mainContent: OmniRetarget 面向人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 与场景交互中的数据瓶颈，目标是将人类动作、物体交互和地形交互重定向为机器人可跟踪的高质量参考轨迹。核心方法是构建包含人体/机器人关键点、物体表面点和环境表面点的 interaction mesh，并通过最小化 Laplacian deformation，同时施加碰撞、关节限位、速度限制和支撑脚固定等硬运动学约束。该方法还能通过改变物体位姿、物体尺寸和地形参数，从单个示范扩增出多样化轨迹。实验在 OMOMO、LAFAN1 和自采 MoCap 数据上生成超过 8 小时轨迹，并训练纯本体感知 RL tracking policy，在 Unitree G1 上实现多种 zero-shot sim-to-real 的长时程场景交互技能。
innovations: 提出 interaction-preserving humanoid retargeting 框架，将机器人/人体关键点、物体表面点和地形采样点统一放入 interaction mesh，用 Laplacian deformation 保持身体、物体和环境之间的空间与接触关系。
将 interaction mesh 目标与硬运动学约束统一到同一个优化问题中，包括碰撞避免、关节范围、速度限制和支撑脚固定，从而减少穿透、脚滑和不可行姿态。
提出系统性数据扩增流程，可以从单个人类示范生成不同机器人 embodiment、物体初始位姿、物体形状和地形参数下的高质量参考轨迹。
展示高质量 retargeted reference 可以显著简化下游 RL：使用纯本体感知观测、5 个 reward terms 和少量 domain randomization，即可训练可 zero-shot transfer 到 Unitree G1 真机的复杂 whole-body interaction policy。
implementation: 输入数据包括 OMOMO 的 SMPL human-object interaction 数据、LAFAN1 的 BVH 动作数据，以及作者自采的 MoCap 地形交互数据；论文将不同格式统一转换为全局 3D keypoint 序列。
retargeting 阶段构造 source 和 target interaction mesh：source 由人体关键点、物体表面采样点和环境采样点组成；target 由机器人正运动学得到的对应关键点、相同物体点和环境点组成。
核心优化变量是机器人广义构型 q_t，包括 floating base pose 和关节角；目标是最小化 source/target mesh 的 Laplacian deformation，并加入时间平滑项。
硬约束包括 signed-distance collision constraint、joint limit、velocity limit 和 stance foot sticking constraint；支撑脚通过源动作中足部水平速度低于 1 cm/s 判断。
优化器采用逐帧 sequential convex / SQP-style 求解，并用上一帧解 warm start；附录进一步说明其实现为 sequential SOCP，每帧最多迭代 10 次，并加入 trust region。
数据扩增包括 robot-object augmentation 和 robot-terrain augmentation：改变物体初始位姿、物体尺寸、平台高度和深度等；每个新场景都重新求解 retargeting optimization，而不是只在 RL 中做随机扰动。
RL policy 是 motion tracking policy，观测包括参考关节位置/速度、参考骨盆位置/姿态误差、本体速度、关节位置/速度和上一时刻动作；对高动态动作，论文会 mask 掉不可靠的骨盆线性位置误差和线速度。
奖励项只有 5 类：body tracking、object tracking、action rate、soft joint limit 和 self-collision；论文说明直接使用 BeyondMimic 的权重和超参数，没有针对每个任务做额外调参。
domain randomization 包括物体质量、质心、惯量和尺寸扰动；机器人侧只使用 torso COM position、joint default position、random push 和 observation noise 四类随机化。
实验在 Unitree G1 上展示 box carrying、platform climbing、slope crawling、chair-assisted parkour、jump-and-roll 和 wall-flip 等真机动作；论文报告 wall-flip 真机 5/5 成功，但多数真机展示主要是定性视频结果。
论文未说明完整的优化耗时、mesh 节点数量、SOCP 求解器细节、每小时数据生成所需计算资源，也未给出完整 RL reward 的具体公式和全部权重。

en.title: OmniRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Data Generation for Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation and Scene Interaction
en.authors: Lujie Yang, Xiaoyu Huang, Zhen Wu, Angjoo Kanazawa, Pieter Abbeel, Carmelo Sferrazza, C. Karen Liu, Rocky Duan, Guanya Shi
en.institutions: Amazon FAR; MIT; UC Berkeley; Stanford University; CMU
en.takeaway: The key lesson is that complex humanoid loco-manipulation becomes much easier when the retargeted references already preserve interaction geometry and satisfy hard kinematic constraints, instead of relying on RL rewards to repair poor references.
en.mainContent: OmniRetarget addresses the data bottleneck for humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation and scene interaction by converting human demonstrations with object and terrain interactions into high-quality robot reference trajectories. The core idea is to build an interaction mesh over body keypoints, object surface samples, and environment samples, then minimize Laplacian deformation while enforcing hard kinematic constraints such as collision avoidance, joint limits, velocity limits, and stance-foot sticking. The same formulation supports systematic data augmentation across object poses, object shapes, terrain variations, and robot embodiments. Experiments on OMOMO, LAFAN1, and in-house MoCap produce over 8 hours of retargeted trajectories and enable proprioceptive RL tracking policies to perform diverse zero-shot sim-to-real skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid.
innovations: Introduces an interaction-preserving humanoid retargeting framework that models body-object-terrain relationships through an interaction mesh and preserves them via Laplacian deformation minimization.

Unifies interaction preservation with hard kinematic constraints, including non-penetration, joint limits, velocity limits, and stance-foot sticking, reducing artifacts such as penetration and foot skating.

Provides a systematic augmentation pipeline that transforms a single human demonstration into diverse robot trajectories across object configurations, object shapes, terrain parameters, and robot embodiments.

Demonstrates that high-quality retargeted references allow a minimal RL formulation: proprioceptive observations, five reward terms, limited domain randomization, and zero-shot transfer to real Unitree G1 hardware.
implementation: Input data comes from OMOMO SMPL human-object interaction motions, LAFAN1 BVH motions, and in-house MoCap terrain-interaction data; these are converted into global 3D keypoint trajectories.

The retargeting stage constructs source and target interaction meshes. The source mesh contains human keypoints, object surface samples, and environment samples; the target mesh replaces human keypoints with robot keypoints computed by forward kinematics while keeping the same object and environment samples.

The optimization variable is the robot generalized configuration q_t, including floating-base pose and joint angles. The objective minimizes source-target Laplacian deformation plus a temporal smoothness term.

Hard constraints include signed-distance collision constraints, joint limits, velocity limits, and stance-foot sticking constraints. Stance feet are detected from source motion when horizontal foot velocity is below 1 cm/s.

The solver uses frame-wise sequential convex / SQP-style optimization with warm start from the previous frame. The appendix specifies a sequential SOCP implementation with up to 10 iterations per frame and a trust region.

Data augmentation includes robot-object and robot-terrain variants, such as changing object initial pose, object size, platform height, and platform depth. Each augmented scenario is solved as a new retargeting optimization rather than only being randomized during RL.

The RL policy is a motion tracking policy with reference joint position/velocity, reference pelvis position/orientation error, proprioceptive velocities, joint states, and previous action as observations. For highly dynamic motions, unreliable pelvis linear position error and velocity are masked out.

The reward uses only five terms: body tracking, object tracking, action rate, soft joint limit, and self-collision. The paper states that it reuses BeyondMimic weights and hyperparameters without per-task tuning.
Domain randomization covers object mass, center of mass, inertia, and shape. Robot-side randomization uses only torso COM position, joint default position, random push, and observation noise.

Hardware demonstrations on Unitree G1 include box carrying, platform climbing, slope crawling, chair-assisted parkour, jump-and-roll, and wall-flip. The paper reports a 5/5 hardware success rate for wall-flip, while most other hardware results are presented qualitatively through videos.
The paper does not specify full optimization runtime, mesh size, detailed SOCP solver settings, compute budget for generating the dataset, or the complete analytic reward formulas and weights.

zh.title: HOVER: Versatile Neural Whole-Body Controller for Humanoid Robots
zh.authors: Tairan He, Wenli Xiao, Toru Lin, Zhengyi Luo, Zhenjia Xu, Zhenyu Jiang, Jan Kautz, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi, Xiaolong Wang, Linxi “Jim” Fan, Yuke Zhu
zh.institutions: NVIDIA; Carnegie Mellon University; UC Berkeley; The University of Texas at Austin; UC San Diego
zh.takeaway: HOVER 将人形机器人的 root tracking、关节角跟踪和关键点位置跟踪统一到一个 masked multi-mode command space 中，并通过 full-body motion imitation oracle 蒸馏出一个可真实部署的通用全身控制器。
zh.mainContent: 本文研究如何为同一台人形机器人训练一个统一的神经全身控制器，使其能够支持 root tracking、局部关节角跟踪和身体关键点位置跟踪等多种控制模式，而不需要为每种任务单独训练策略。方法上，作者先基于 AMASS 人体动作数据重定向得到可行的人形机器人动作数据集，并用 PPO 训练一个 full-body motion imitation oracle policy；随后通过 DAgger 蒸馏，将 oracle 的全身运动能力迁移到一个只依赖可部署 proprioception history 和 masked multi-mode command 的 HOVER student policy 中。实验在 IsaacGym 和真实 Unitree H1 上验证，结果显示 HOVER 在多种 prior-work command mode 和单手、双手、头部等 sparse control mode 下通常优于单独训练的 specialist policies，并能在真实机器人上进行模式切换和遥操作演示。
innovations: 提出统一的 versatile multi-mode command space，将 kinematic position tracking、local joint angle tracking 和 root tracking 整合到同一个人形全身控制接口中。
使用 mode mask 和 sparsity mask 对 command space 进行选择性激活，使同一个 policy 可以在 ExBody、H2O、OmniH2O、HumanPlus、head-only、left-hand-only、two-hands 等多种模式下工作。
采用 oracle-to-student policy distillation：先用 full-body reference motion 训练 privileged oracle motion imitator，再通过 DAgger 将其蒸馏为可真实部署的 HOVER policy。
实验显示，HOVER 作为 generalist policy 在多个单模式评估中通常优于对应的 RL specialist，并且优于直接从零训练的 multi-mode RL baseline。
implementation: 数据来源为 AMASS 人体 MoCap 数据；作者通过 humanoid forward kinematics、SMPL fitting、keypoint matching 和 sim-to-data 流程，将人类动作重定向为只包含 humanoid feasible motions 的数据集。
Oracle policy 输入 privileged full-body proprioception 和完整 full-body reference goal，其中 proprioception 包含刚体位置、朝向、线速度、角速度和上一时刻动作；goal 包含当前参考 pose 以及下一帧 reference 与当前状态之间的差异。
Oracle policy 使用 PPO 训练，输出 19 维 target joint positions，并通过 PD controller 驱动机器人关节；网络结构采用三层 MLP，层维度为 [512, 256, 128]。
Student / HOVER policy 输入真实机器人可获得的 proprioception history，包括关节位置、关节速度、base angular velocity、gravity vector 和 action history，并堆叠最近 25 步历史。
Student 的 command input 由 mode mask 和 sparsity mask 生成，可从完整 reference 中选择 upper-body / lower-body 的 keypoint positions、joint angles 和 root commands 的任意子集。
Student 训练采用 DAgger：在仿真中 rollout student，每个 timestep 查询 oracle action，并最小化 student action 与 oracle action 之间的 L2 loss。
真实机器人实验平台为 19-DOF Unitree H1，论文报告其质量约 51.5 kg、高度约 1.8 m；实验包括 standing motion tracking、locomotion mode switching 和 Vision Pro 遥操作演示。
论文未说明完整代码、训练超参数、训练时长、mask 向量是否显式 concatenate 到网络输入、AMASS 子集划分、retargeted motion 文件格式和具体 domain randomization 参数。

en.title: HOVER: Versatile Neural Whole-Body Controller for Humanoid Robots
en.authors: Tairan He, Wenli Xiao, Toru Lin, Zhengyi Luo, Zhenjia Xu, Zhenyu Jiang, Jan Kautz, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi, Xiaolong Wang, Linxi “Jim” Fan, Yuke Zhu
en.institutions: NVIDIA; Carnegie Mellon University; UC Berkeley; The University of Texas at Austin; UC San Diego
en.takeaway: HOVER unifies root tracking, joint-angle tracking, and keypoint-position tracking into a masked multi-mode command space, then distills a full-body motion imitation oracle into a deployable generalist humanoid controller.
en.mainContent: This paper studies how to train a unified neural whole-body controller for a humanoid robot that can support multiple control modes, including root tracking, local joint-angle tracking, and body-keypoint position tracking, without retraining a separate policy for each task. The method first retargets AMASS human motion data into feasible humanoid motions and trains a privileged full-body motion imitation oracle with PPO. HOVER is then obtained by DAgger-style policy distillation, where the student receives deployable proprioception history and masked multi-mode commands while imitating the oracle's actions. Experiments in IsaacGym and on a real Unitree H1 show that HOVER often outperforms specialist policies under prior-work modes and sparse modes such as single-hand, two-hand, and head-only tracking, while also supporting real-world mode switching and teleoperation.
innovations: Introduces a unified versatile multi-mode command space that combines kinematic position tracking, local joint-angle tracking, and root tracking for humanoid whole-body control.

Uses mode masks and sparsity masks to selectively activate subsets of the command space, enabling one policy to operate under ExBody, H2O, OmniH2O, HumanPlus, head-only, left-hand-only, two-hand, and other modes.
Uses oracle-to-student policy distillation: a privileged full-body motion imitation oracle is first trained with full reference motions, then distilled into a deployable HOVER policy through DAgger.
Shows that the generalist HOVER policy typically outperforms RL-trained specialist policies under multiple fixed command modes and also outperforms a multi-mode RL baseline trained from scratch.
implementation: The motion source is AMASS human MoCap data. The paper retargets it to the humanoid through humanoid forward kinematics, SMPL fitting, keypoint matching, and a sim-to-data procedure to obtain feasible humanoid motions.

The oracle policy takes privileged full-body proprioception and a full-body reference goal. Its proprioception includes rigid-body positions, orientations, linear velocities, angular velocities, and the previous action; its goal includes the current reference pose and one-frame differences between the next reference and the current state.

The oracle is trained with PPO, outputs 19-dimensional target joint positions, and uses a PD controller to actuate the robot. The policy network follows a three-layer MLP with dimensions [512, 256, 128].

The student / HOVER policy takes deployable proprioception history, including joint positions, joint velocities, base angular velocity, gravity vector, and action history, stacked over the last 25 steps.

The student command input is generated with mode and sparsity masks, selecting arbitrary subsets of upper-body and lower-body keypoint positions, joint angles, and root commands from the full reference motion.
Student training uses DAgger: the student is rolled out in simulation, the oracle is queried at every timestep, and the student minimizes the L2 loss between its action and the oracle action.

The real-world platform is a 19-DOF Unitree H1 humanoid, reported as around 51.5 kg and 1.8 m tall. Experiments include standing motion tracking, locomotion mode switching, and Vision Pro teleoperation demos.

The paper does not specify full code-level details, complete training hyperparameters, training time, whether mask bits are explicitly concatenated to the network input, AMASS split details, the retargeted motion file format, or the exact domain randomization ranges.

zh.title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
zh.authors: Tairan He, Zhengyi Luo, Xialin He, Wenli Xiao, Chong Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Kris Kitani, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi
zh.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
zh.takeaway: OmniH2O 将运动学姿态作为统一控制接口，用 teacher-student sim-to-real 策略把 VR、RGB、语言、GPT-4o 和示范学习产生的高层目标稳定转化为全尺寸人形机器人的全身运动与灵巧操作。
zh.mainContent: 本文提出 OmniH2O，一个面向全尺寸人形机器人的学习式全身遥操作与自主控制系统，目标是在真实世界中同时支持稳定 locomotion、上肢灵巧操作和可扩展数据采集。核心方法是使用 kinematic pose 作为统一中间控制接口，先在仿真中训练具有 privileged information 的 teacher policy，再通过 DAgger 蒸馏到只依赖稀疏头手目标和真实可用本体历史的 student policy。系统支持 VR、RGB、语言到运动模型 MDM、GPT-4o motion primitive selection，以及基于遥操作数据训练的 Diffusion Policy / BC 自主策略。论文还发布 OmniH2O-6 数据集，包含六个真实人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 任务，用于验证从遥操作示范中学习自主技能。
innovations: 提出以 kinematic pose / sparse motion goal 作为通用控制接口，使 VR、RGB、语言模型、GPT-4o 和 LfD policy 都能接入同一个人形机器人低层全身控制策略。
采用 privileged teacher policy 与 DAgger student distillation 的 sim-to-real 训练流程，使部署策略只依赖真实可获得的传感输入，而不依赖 MoCap 提供的全局线速度。
使用 25 步本体历史信息隐式补偿全局线速度估计，真实实验中避免了 VIO 线速度估计噪声导致的部署问题。
通过 retargeted AMASS 数据、standing / squatting motion augmentation、reward curriculum 和 domain randomization，提高人形机器人在站立操作、下蹲操作和扰动环境中的稳定性。
发布 OmniH2O-6 数据集，并在真实人形机器人上展示基于 Diffusion Policy 的 Learning from Demonstrations，用第一人称视觉预测未来稀疏运动目标，再由 OmniH2O 低层策略执行。
implementation: 低层控制问题被建模为 goal-conditioned RL；动作为 19 维身体关节目标角，由 PD controller 执行，论文中控制策略频率为 50 Hz，PD 控制频率为 200 Hz。
Teacher policy 输入包含 humanoid rigid-body position、orientation、linear velocity、angular velocity、previous action 以及完整 reference pose / difference motion goal；使用 PPO 训练，状态维度为 913。
Student policy 即 OmniH2O 部署策略，输入为头和双手 3 点 motion goal，以及 25 步历史的 DoF position、DoF velocity、root angular velocity、root gravity 和 previous actions；不使用 global linear velocity，状态维度为 1665。
Policy distillation 使用 DAgger：在仿真中 rollout student，构造对应 privileged state，查询 teacher 得到 reference action，并用 L2 action matching loss 训练 student。
灵巧手控制使用 VR 估计 hand pose，再通过 inverse kinematics 计算 joint targets，并交给 off-the-shelf low-level hand controller；论文说明该 hand pose interface 可替换为 MoCap gloves 或 RGB cameras。
语言控制部分连接 pretrained text-to-motion generative model MDM，由自然语言生成 motion goals，再由 OmniH2O 跟踪执行。
GPT-4o 自主控制部分使用头戴相机第一人称 RGB 图像，让 GPT-4o 根据视觉上下文在预定义 motion primitives 中选择动作；论文说明由于 GPT-4o 响应较慢，主实验采用 primitive selection 而不是实时连续 motion goal 生成。
LfD 部分将策略定义为从第一人称图像预测未来若干帧 sparse motion goals 和 dexterous hand commands；实验比较 vanilla BC with ResNet、Diffusion Policy with DDIM 和 Diffusion Policy with DDPM。
OmniH2O-6 数据集由 VR 遥操作采集，包含 Catch-Release、Squat、Rock-Paper-Scissors、Hammer-Catch、Boxing、Basket-Pick-Place 六个任务，总计约 40 分钟，数据包括头部 RGBD、头和双手相对 root 的 motion goals 以及 motor joint targets，频率为 30 Hz。
论文未说明完整训练墙钟时间、并行仿真环境数量、模型参数量，以及跨不同人形机器人平台的迁移实现细节。

en.title: OmniH2O: Universal and Dexterous Human-to-Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation and Learning
en.authors: Tairan He, Zhengyi Luo, Xialin He, Wenli Xiao, Chong Zhang, Weinan Zhang, Kris Kitani, Changliu Liu, Guanya Shi
en.institutions: Carnegie Mellon University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
en.takeaway: OmniH2O uses kinematic pose as a universal control interface and distills a privileged sim-to-real teacher into a deployable student policy, enabling VR, RGB, language, GPT-4o, and demonstration-learned goals to drive full-size humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.
en.mainContent: This paper presents OmniH2O, a learning-based whole-body teleoperation and autonomy system for full-size humanoids with dexterous hands. The core idea is to use kinematic pose as a universal intermediate control interface, train a privileged teacher policy in simulation, and distill it via DAgger into a real-world deployable student policy using sparse head-and-hand goals and proprioceptive history. The same low-level controller can be driven by VR, RGB cameras, verbal instructions through MDM, GPT-4o primitive selection, or imitation policies trained from teleoperated demonstrations. The paper also releases OmniH2O-6, a real-world humanoid loco-manipulation dataset with six everyday tasks.
innovations: Introduces kinematic pose and sparse motion goals as a universal humanoid control interface compatible with VR, RGB, language models, GPT-4o, and LfD policies.
Uses a privileged teacher policy and DAgger-based student distillation to obtain a sim-to-real deployable whole-body controller that does not require MoCap-based global linear velocity.
Leverages 25-step proprioceptive history to implicitly recover motion information and improve real-world robustness without explicit global linear velocity input.
Improves standing and squatting manipulation through retargeted AMASS motions, standing/squatting motion augmentation, reward curriculum, and domain randomization.

Releases OmniH2O-6 and demonstrates humanoid Learning from Demonstrations by predicting future sparse motion goals from egocentric visual observations and executing them with the OmniH2O low-level controller.
implementation: The low-level control problem is formulated as goal-conditioned RL. The action is a 19-dimensional body joint target vector, executed by a PD controller. The policy runs at 50 Hz and the PD controller runs at 200 Hz.

The teacher policy observes privileged rigid-body position, orientation, linear velocity, angular velocity, previous action, and full reference pose / motion-goal differences. It is trained with PPO and has a 913-dimensional state.

The deployable student policy observes 3-point head-and-hand motion goals and 25-step histories of DoF position, DoF velocity, root angular velocity, root gravity, and previous actions. It excludes global linear velocity and has a 1665-dimensional state.
Policy distillation follows DAgger: roll out the student in simulation, construct the corresponding privileged state, query the teacher for reference actions, and optimize an L2 action-matching loss.

Dexterous hand control uses VR-estimated hand poses, inverse kinematics, and an off-the-shelf low-level hand controller. The paper notes that the hand-pose interface could be replaced by MoCap gloves or RGB cameras.
Language control is enabled by connecting OmniH2O with a pretrained text-to-motion generative model, MDM, which converts verbal instructions into motion goals tracked by the low-level policy.

GPT-4o autonomous control uses egocentric RGB images from a head-mounted camera and prompts GPT-4o to select from predefined motion primitives. The paper chooses primitive selection rather than direct continuous motion-goal generation because of GPT-4o's relatively long response time.

The LfD policy maps egocentric images to future sparse motion goals and dexterous hand commands. The paper benchmarks vanilla BC with ResNet, Diffusion Policy with DDIM, and Diffusion Policy with DDPM.

OmniH2O-6 is collected through VR teleoperation and includes six tasks: Catch-Release, Squat, Rock-Paper-Scissors, Hammer-Catch, Boxing, and Basket-Pick-Place. It contains about 40 minutes of data with head-mounted RGBD images, root-relative head-and-hand motion goals, and motor joint targets at 30 Hz.

The paper does not specify full wall-clock training time, the number of parallel simulation environments, model parameter counts, or implementation details for transferring the system across different humanoid platforms.

zh.title: SMP: Reusable Score-Matching Motion Priors for Physics-Based Character Control
zh.authors: Yuxuan Mu, Ziyu Zhang, Yi Shi, Dun Yang, Minami Matsumoto, Kotaro Imamura, Guy Tevet, Chuan Guo, Michael Taylor, Chang Shu, Pengcheng Xi, Xue Bin Peng
zh.institutions: Simon Fraser University; Sony Interactive Entertainment; Stanford University; Snap Inc.; National Research Council Canada; NVIDIA
zh.takeaway: 把预训练运动扩散模型冻结为可复用的自然性奖励，用 SDS/score matching 替代每个任务都要重训的对抗式 motion prior。
zh.mainContent: 论文研究如何为物理仿真人形角色构造可复用、模块化的运动先验，使新任务策略在不持续访问原始动作数据的情况下仍能产生自然动作。方法先在动作数据上训练任务无关的运动扩散模型，再冻结该模型，并通过 score distillation sampling 将其转化为 motion naturalness reward，与任务奖励一起训练 PPO 控制策略。实验覆盖 100STYLE 多风格控制、多任务 locomotion、dodgeball、object carry、stair traversal、getup、单 clip imitation 与 Unitree G1 真机部署，结果显示运动质量接近 AMP，同时显著提升先验的复用性。
innovations: 提出 Score-Matching Motion Prior：将预训练 motion diffusion model 冻结后作为通用奖励模型，用 SDS error 衡量策略生成运动与参考动作分布的相似性。
相比 AMP/GAIL 类对抗运动先验，SMP 不需要为每个新任务持续重训判别器，也不需要在下游策略训练时长期保留原始 reference motion dataset。
提出或采用面向 RL 稳定性的 Ensemble Score-Matching、adaptive normalization 与 Generative State Initialization，使扩散先验既能提供奖励，也能生成策略训练初始状态。
通过 classifier-free guidance 生成 style-specific priors，并在 epsilon-space 组合不同风格，得到训练数据中不存在的新风格运动先验。
implementation: 运动表示包含 root 线速度与角速度、局部关节旋转，以及手脚等 end-effector 的 3D 位置；特征均在角色局部坐标系下计算，球形关节使用 6D rotation representation。
扩散模型使用两层 Transformer encoder、adaptive normalization、10 帧 motion window、N=50 个 diffusion timesteps，约 3M 参数；论文报告在 100STYLE 约 20 小时数据上也可建模，训练 400k-800k iterations，单张 RTX 4090 约 5 小时收敛。
策略训练使用 PPO；MLP policy 输入当前状态与任务目标，输出高斯动作分布，动作是各关节 PD controller 的目标关节位置；总奖励为 task reward 与 SMP reward 的线性组合。
SMP reward 由 r_smp = exp(-w_s ||eps_hat - eps||^2) 构造；默认 Ensemble Score-Matching 在 K={22,15,8} 三个 diffusion timesteps 上平均 SDS error，并配合 adaptive normalization 降低奖励尺度差异。
Generative State Initialization 用同一个扩散先验生成初始化状态，以减少下游训练对原始动作数据的依赖；真实 G1 部署使用本体感知观测、asymmetric actor-critic 与 domain randomization。

en.title: SMP: Reusable Score-Matching Motion Priors for Physics-Based Character Control
en.authors: Yuxuan Mu, Ziyu Zhang, Yi Shi, Dun Yang, Minami Matsumoto, Kotaro Imamura, Guy Tevet, Chuan Guo, Michael Taylor, Chang Shu, Pengcheng Xi, Xue Bin Peng
en.institutions: Simon Fraser University; Sony Interactive Entertainment; Stanford University; Snap Inc.; National Research Council Canada; NVIDIA
en.takeaway: Freeze a pretrained motion diffusion model as a reusable naturalness reward, replacing task-specific adversarial motion priors with SDS-based score matching.
en.mainContent: This paper studies how to build reusable and modular motion priors for physically simulated humanoid characters, so that downstream policies can produce natural behavior without continuously accessing the original motion dataset. SMP first trains a task-agnostic motion diffusion model on motion data, freezes it, and repurposes it through score distillation sampling as a motion-naturalness reward combined with task rewards in PPO. Experiments cover 100STYLE multi-style control, locomotion tasks, dodgeball, object carry, stair traversal, getup, single-clip imitation, and Unitree G1 deployment, showing motion quality comparable to AMP while substantially improving reusability.
innovations: Introduces Score-Matching Motion Priors, which freeze a pretrained motion diffusion model and use SDS error as a reusable reward measuring similarity to the reference motion distribution.
Unlike AMP/GAIL-style adversarial priors, SMP does not require retraining a discriminator for each downstream controller or retaining the reference dataset throughout policy training.

Uses RL-oriented stabilizing designs including Ensemble Score-Matching, adaptive normalization, and Generative State Initialization, allowing the same diffusion prior to serve as both reward model and initialization sampler.
Supports style-specific priors via classifier-free guidance and new composed styles by blending style-conditioned diffusion predictions in epsilon-space.
implementation: Motion features include root linear/angular velocities, local joint rotations, and 3D end-effector positions, all represented in the character's local frame; spherical joint rotations use a 6D representation.

The diffusion model is a two-layer Transformer encoder with adaptive normalization, 10-frame motion windows, N=50 diffusion timesteps, and about 3M parameters; the paper reports 400k-800k training iterations and convergence in about five hours on a single RTX 4090.

Policy training uses PPO. The MLP policy maps state and task goal to a Gaussian action distribution, and actions specify target joint positions for PD controllers. The composite reward is a linear combination of task reward and SMP reward.

The SMP reward is r_smp = exp(-w_s ||eps_hat - eps||^2). By default, Ensemble Score-Matching averages SDS errors at K={22,15,8} diffusion timesteps and uses adaptive normalization to reduce timestep-dependent scale variation.

Generative State Initialization samples initial states from the same diffusion prior, reducing downstream dependence on the original motion clips. Real-world G1 deployment uses proprioceptive observations, asymmetric actor-critic training, and domain randomization.
